author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: VOLTA is an AI-powered infostealer that steals personal data, then uses LLMs to assess victims’ value and rank targets for attackers. title: VOLTA, the infostealer that asks an AI which victims are worth the effort

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A new wave of fridge cyberattacks hit supermarket refrigeration systems across five European countries, raising temperatures and causing food losses. A new wave of fridge cyberattacks has affected supermarket refrigeration systems in several European countries. Fridges and freezers suddenly rose in temperature overnight, with some incidents suspected to be caused by hackers. On Monday, November […]
title: New wave of fridge cyberattacks hits European supermarkets, this time in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden and Estonia

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hackers reportedly hit Ukraine ‘s and Russia ‘s emergency alert apps, sending fake nuclear and attack warnings and raising concerns over public safety. Ukraine and Russia both said on Sunday night that hackers had compromised their emergency alert apps and used them to send fake warnings about air raids and other attacks, including nuclear threats. title: Hackers Send Fake Nuclear Threat Alerts to Ukrainian and Russian Citizens

title: Chainalysis Investigates Security Incident Involving AI-Driven Attack Techniques
